facts.fact: Universal Ads offers free, automated AI creative production sourced from a advertiser's website or social channels for advertisers without commercials ready.
facts.quote: Free, automated AI creative production sourced from your website or social channels if you don't have commercials ready to go.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states its platform connects buyers and sellers so they transact directly without hidden or unnecessary fees.
facts.quote: allowing them to transact directly without any hidden or unnecessary fees

facts.fact: Per a MediaPost article cited by Universal Ads, CTV delivers an ROI 30% higher than other media channels while representing only 7% of total media spend.
facts.quote: CTV delivers an ROI 30% higher than other media channels while only representing 7% of total media spend

facts.fact: Per WorldMetrics, as cited by Universal Ads, 43% of viewers report making a purchase after seeing a CTV ad.
facts.quote: 43% of viewers report making a purchase after seeing a CTV ad

facts.fact: Per a 2024 GlobeNewswire release on a tvScientific study cited by Universal Ads, brands that integrate TV with digital channels report a 65% higher impact on sales.
facts.quote: Brands that integrate TV with digital channels report a **65% higher impact on sales**

facts.fact: Universal Ads states its premium, brand-safe inventory reaches over 90% of US households.
facts.quote: the premium, brand-safe inventory that reaches over 90% of US households

facts.fact: Universal Ads lists A+E, AMC Networks, DIRECTV, Fox Corporation, NBCUniversal, Paramount, Roku, TelevisaUnivision, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Xumo as publisher partners.
facts.quote: Our partners include A+E, AMC Networks, DIRECTV, Fox Corporation, NBCUniversal, Paramount, Roku, TelevisaUnivision, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Xumo.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states its platform is built on FreeWheel technology.
facts.quote: Our platform, which is built on robust [FreeWheel](https://www.freewheel.com/) technology

facts.fact: Universal Ads' self-service platform offers precise targeting based on location, demographics, viewership and more.
facts.quote: Reach specific audiences based on location, demographics, viewership and more.

facts.fact: The Universal Ads blog post was published on September 15, 2026.
